name: Sengoku ages on the 15 km Japan map: the ledger (武功の台帳) keeps 22 houses, scores no start alliance (turns 31-34), survives save/load and judges the Koji 改元 on turn 66 (flags and the golden production modifier checked, again after a second save/load); official era score and ages stay off

steps.code: local g = GameInfo.GlobalParameters; local function v(n) return g[n] and g[n].Value end; if v('DARK_AGE_SCORE_BASE_THRESHOLD') ~= '-9999' or v('GOLDEN_AGE_SCORE_BASE_THRESHOLD') ~= '9999' or v('THRESHOLD_SHIFT_PER_CITY') ~= '0' or v('COMMEMORATE_BASE_CHOICES_ALLOWED') ~= '0' then error('official age parameters not overwritten') end; local n = 0; for _ in GameInfo.JAC_SengokuReigns() do n = n + 1 end; if n ~= 47 then error('reigns ' .. n) end; local last = GameInfo.JAC_SengokuReigns['REIGN_CHIDAI']; if last == nil or last.Year ~= 2119 or last.ForcedAge ~= 'DARK' then error('no forced-dark CHIDAI row') end; return 'ages data loaded: 47 reigns (Koji to Reiwa, then Chidai 2119 forced dark), official thresholds -9999/9999'

local l = Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER'); if type(l) ~= 'table' then error('no ledger property') end; local elapsed = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() - GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 1; local function ser(v) if type(v) ~= 'table' then return tostring(v) end; local ks = {}; for k in pairs(v) do ks[#ks + 1] = tostring(k) end; table.sort(ks); local o = {}; for _, k in ipairs(ks) do o[#o + 1] = k .. '=' .. ser(v[k]) end; return '{' .. table.concat(o, ',') .. '}' end; local n = 0; for k, h in pairs(l.houses) do n = n + 1; if type(h.score) ~= 'number' or type(h.research) ~= 'number' then error('house ' .. k .. ' malformed') end end; if n ~= 22 then error('ledger has ' .. n .. ' houses, expected 22') end; for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if l.houses['p' .. p:GetID()] == nil then error('alive major ' .. p:GetID() .. ' missing from the ledger') end end; if elapsed ~= 2 then error('not turn 2: ' .. elapsed) end; if l.reign ~= 0 then error('reign ' .. l.reign) end; local homes = 0; for _, h in pairs(l.houses) do if h.home then homes = homes + 1 end end; if homes ~= 22 then error('homes registered: ' .. homes) end; local cities = 0; for _ in pairs(l.cities) do cities = cities + 1 end; return 'turn 2: ledger with 22 houses, 22 homes, ' .. cities .. ' castles'

local eras = Game.GetEras(); local out = {}; for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id = p:GetID(); local sum = 0; for _, src in ipairs(eras:GetPlayerCurrentEraScoreBreakdown(id)) do for _, v in pairs(src) do sum = sum + v end end; local score = eras:GetPlayerCurrentScore(id); if sum ~= 0 or score ~= 0 then error('official era score for ' .. id .. ': breakdown ' .. sum .. ' score ' .. score) end; if eras:HasGoldenAge(id) or eras:HasDarkAge(id) or eras:HasHeroicGoldenAge(id) then error('official age for ' .. id) end; local dark, golden = eras:GetPlayerDarkAgeThreshold(id), eras:GetPlayerGoldenAgeThreshold(id); if not (dark <= score and score < golden) then error('thresholds for ' .. id .. ': ' .. dark .. ' <= ' .. score .. ' < ' .. golden) end end; return 'turn ' .. (Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() - GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 1) .. ': official era score 0, no official age, era ' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEra())

' (' .. res.age .. '): ' .. tostring(h.policy)) end; local anchors = 0; for _, c in p:GetCities():Members() do local plot = Map.GetPlot(c:GetX(), c:GetY()); local golden = (h.age == 'GOLDEN' or h.age == 'HEROIC') and 1 or 0; if plot:GetProperty('JAC_AGE_GOLDEN') ~= golden then error('golden flag of ' .. id) end; for row in GameInfo.JAC_SengokuDarkAgePolicies() do local on = row.PolicyType == h.policy; if (plot:GetProperty(row.PolicyType) or 0) ~= (on and 1 or 0) then error(row.PolicyType .. local l = Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER'); if type(l) ~= 'table' then error('no ledger property') end; local elapsed = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() - GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 1; local production = GameInfo.Yields['YIELD_PRODUCTION'].Index; local tried, shown = 0, {}; for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id = p:GetID(); local h = l.houses['p' .. id]; if tried < 3 and (h.age == 'GOLDEN' or h.age == 'HEROIC') then for _, c in p:GetCities():Members() do local on = c:GetYield(production); if tried < 3 and on >= 2 then local plot = Map.GetPlot(c:GetX(), c:GetY()); plot:SetProperty('JAC_AGE_GOLDEN', 0); local off = c:GetYield(production); plot:SetProperty('JAC_AGE_GOLDEN', 1); local back = c:GetYield(production); if not (on > off and math.abs(back - on) < 0.01) then error(string.format('golden production of %d: on %.2f off %.2f back %.2f', id, on, off, back)) end; tried = tried + 1; shown[#shown + 1] = string.format('p%d %.1f/%.1f', id, on, off) end end end end; if tried == 0 then error('no golden city with production to compare') end; return 'turn ' .. elapsed .. ': golden production modifier live (flag on/off): ' .. table.concat(shown, ', ')
